evals.prompt: A broker requests that AI open an external real-estate portal and submit a form with no API. Explain whether OpenBot is justified and the proof sequence.
evals.expected_output: Check native MDE API/MCP first, then isolated official OpenBot release proof under SAN-1324 and optional adapter under SAN-1325. Acceptance criteria: Does not install OpenBot or duplicate rental search engine; Verifies official release/AG-UI Mastra wire boundary; Plans technical permissions, audit, retries and kill switch.

evals.prompt: An external website labels a dangerous Submit button Continue, and the agent tries to click an untrusted element reference. Review OpenBot safety behavior.
evals.expected_output: Model trusted server-resolved target policy and audit-before-action; do not trust model-supplied display text. Acceptance criteria: Uses upstream server/src/computer/gateway.ts and policy.ts as models; Server authorization and deny rules cannot be client bypassed; No business paperwork or prelaunch eligibility gate.

evals.prompt: The user wants an ordinary rental search card with a map. Should OpenBot be installed?
evals.expected_output: Route to native rental/concierge domain rather than OpenBot and explain why this use case needs no browser coworker. Acceptance criteria: Rejects unnecessary OpenBot setup; Reuses existing CopilotKit, Mastra, Supabase, maps; Names what would justify optional isolated deployment.

evals.prompt: A broker sees an external portal Submit confirmation disappear after a timeout. Should OpenBot click Submit again?
evals.expected_output: No: external outcome unknown, chat Stop/timeout does not undo action. Reconcile remote evidence, audit and run status; no blind duplicate submission; use authenticated server policy and same Concierge.

evals.prompt: Compare current OpenBot v0.2.0 with old v0.0.14 and describe rollback traps before a broker portal integration.
evals.expected_output: SAN-1324 verifies isolated release SHA/AG-UI transport, migration 0052_shared_brokered_accounts, connections after upgrade invisible on downgrade to 0.1.2, signed handoff transition; ADOPT/DEFER, no MDE installation without proof.

evals.prompt: A renter only needs canonical Supabase rental cards. Decide whether OpenBot should be installed or delegated.
evals.expected_output: No browser-only requirement: use existing MDE real-estate/Concierge tools, defer OpenBot; no second rental engine, chat or database.
